title: Master status shows delivery speed with no slow events query after an item changes stage
description: On a running test install seeded with 50 merged items of 800-row delta chains on 180 KB documents, an item changes stage and merges; master status shows its delivery speed and the server reports no events query over 3 seconds. Stage reads avoid opening whole snapshot payloads; the retired backfill route returns 404 and status has no backfill field.

steps.name: master status after a stage change shows delivery speed and no events query over 3 s
